docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,400.00 FILED BY RAGUDO DOLORES AS TO DEFENDANT ARROYO AGNES ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-21-1992 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 04
INVALID SERVICE AS TO AGNES ARROYO; SIGNATURE OF SERVER IS THE SAME AS DEFEND.'S NAME.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RAGUDO DOLORES RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ARROYO AGNES $2,000.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,000.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
